title: Certificate Rotation Runbook
body:
# Certificate Rotation Runbook

## Preconditions
- Access to the secrets vault and the AcmePay merchant portal.

## Steps
1. Generate a new CSR with the current CA bundle.
2. Upload the CSR to the merchant portal and download the signed certificate.
3. Store it in the vault under payments/acmepay/mtls and restart the gateway pods.

## Stop and escalate
- Stop if the portal rejects the CSR twice; escalate to the security on-call.
- Do not delete the old certificate until the new one passes the health check.

## Success checks
- The gateway health check reports a valid client certificate with the new expiry date.
